description:
what is CRED?
 
CRED is an exclusive community for india’s most trustworthy and creditworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. 
 
CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true. 
 
here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better. 
 
You’ll play a pivotal role in leading CRED's partner ecosystem across products, becoming the face of CRED to some of India’s top consumer brands. You will lead high-stakes partnerships, drive product adoption, and enable new growth through strategic merchant alliances. As a core part of the merchant-led growth (mlg) strategy, you’ll shape how millions engage with CRED.

title: Deployment Strategist
description: About the Team The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform. You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how." Role Description As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption. You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production. This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset. The impact you will have C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline. End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against. Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early. Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution. Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering. What we look for Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions. Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome. Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions. Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting. Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery. About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. title: SAP Functional SME
description: GAQ226R76 About Databricks At Databricks, our mission is to help data teams solve the world's toughest problems—and that begins with empowering our own employees with exceptional internal products. The Databricks IT organization is a product-led engineering team building intelligent, AI-powered platforms that simplify how work gets done across the company. For Finance, our vision is to eliminate manual, repetitive work by automating complex business processes, surfacing actionable insights, and orchestrating end-to-end workflows. We are reimagining finance operations so teams spend less time processing transactions, chasing approvals, and resolving exceptions, and more time delivering strategic insights that accelerate the business. We're looking for an SAP Functional SME to own the functional design of our core finance processes on S/4HANA and to shape how AI and agentic automation reimagine them. In this role, you'll be the deep functional authority for your domain—translating how the business actually runs into standard, clean-core S/4HANA solutions, using process intelligence to find what's broken, and defining where AI belongs in a controlled, auditable process . You'll work at the intersection of SAP and AI, bridging Finance and Engineering to deliver a simpler, smarter, more automated experience. The Opportunity SAP will serve as the foundation for Databricks' core finance processes, including Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, and Order-to-Cash. As the SAP Functional SME, you'll own the functional blueprint for those processes—leading discovery and AS-IS/TO-BE design, configuring S/4HANA, and defining the requirements for the intelligent, agentic layer that automates routine work and guides users through exceptions and approvals. You'll use process mining and business process intelligence to quantify opportunity and prioritize what to build, and you'll make the call on where AI-driven recommendations belong versus deterministic rules. Your mission is to combine deep functional expertise with the power of Databricks AI to create a modern, highly automated finance experience that lets the business scale. What You'll Do Own Functional Design: Lead end-to-end process discovery and AS-IS/TO-BE design for major finance processes (Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash), define S/4HANA solution scope, and design to standard, clean-core capabilities wherever possible. Configure S/4HANA: Own functional configuration, business rules, and master-data strategy for your domain, and partner with developers on extensions, APIs, and orchestration where standard functionality falls short. Drive Process Intelligence: Use process mining and business process intelligence (leveraging SAP Process Intelligence and related tools) to identify root causes, quantify opportunity, and prioritize improvements; translate those findings into concrete S/4HANA requirements. Shape the AI & Agentic Layer: Define the requirements for AI-assisted and agentic process improvements—task automation, intelligent recommendations, anomaly detection, and generative assistants—and make clear judgments about where AI belongs in a controlled, auditable process, where human-in-the-loop is required, and where a deterministic rule is the better answer. Bridge Business and Engineering: Serve as the connective tissue between Finance process owners and the engineering pods, partnering with architects and developers to embed AI safely and to define the data flows between S/4HANA, process intelligence tools, SAP BTP, and Databricks AI. Run Workshops and Validate Value: Facilitate stakeholder workshops to validate business value, define acceptance criteria, and lead user acceptance testing for both functional and AI features. Measure Outcomes: Define KPIs and track ROI for process improvements—cycle time, touchless transaction rate, exception and manual-touch reduction, adoption—and build the business cases for prioritized automation and AI initiatives. Enable Adoption: Coach and upskill process owners and functional teams on process intelligence, best practices, and AI adoption, and drive readiness and change management for what you ship. What You Bring 6+ years of SAP functional consulting experience , with hands-on delivery across at least one full S/4HANA lifecycle and deep expertise in one or more finance domains—Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, or Order-to-Cash—plus working fluency in adjacent areas and in master-data governance. Process Intelligence: Demonstrated experience leading process discovery, process mapping, and process mining using SAP Process Intelligence or equivalent BPI tools, and translating mining outputs into solution requirements. Clean-Core Mindset: Strong bias toward standard, clean-core S/4HANA design, with sound judgment about when a requirement genuinely warrants an extension versus a change in process. AI & Agentic Automation: Practical experience applying Databricks AI and agentic capabilities to enterprise processes, with strong judgment on where AI can drive automation and decision support while maintaining appropriate governance, controls, auditability, and human oversight. Integration Awareness: Solid understanding of integration patterns (APIs/OData, IDoc, SAP Integration Suite / BTP) and the data requirements that feed process mining and AI models. Governance Rigor: Working knowledge of SAP authorizations, SoD, SOX and audit requirements, and the ability to design processes and automation that satisfy them. Stakeholder Leadership: Excellent workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, and change-management skills, and the ability to present executive-level ROI and translate technical capability into measurable business value. Business-First Mindset: Pragmatic, outcome-driven approach to reducing process waste and risk, and comfort leading through ambiguity across complex business and IT landscapes. Preferred Qualifications SAP S/4HANA Associate or Professional certification for a relevant module, and SAP Activate methodology experience. Certification or training in SAP Process Intelligence, or experience with Celonis or other process mining vendors. Hands-on experience delivering at least one AI-assisted process improvement in production. Familiarity with the SAP AI and extension stack (BTP, AI Core, Joule) and a point of view on build-versus-adopt tradeoffs against a Databricks-native approach. Experience working alongside data teams to make ERP data usable for analytics and AI on modern data platforms (such as Databricks), and prior work in a high-growth technology company where ERP had to scale quickly. title: Sales Specialist - Lakebase
description: SLSQ427R256 Databricks is seeking a Lakebase Sales Specialist Account Executive to help customers modernize their operational data foundation with Databricks Lakebase, our fully-managed Postgres offering for intelligent applications. This high-impact role sits within the Lakebase Go-To-Market team and partners closely with regional Account Executives to drive adoption of Lakebase with platform, application, and data teams. Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for operational workloads and AI-native applications, helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity. The impact you will have Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and closing Lakebase opportunities within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team. Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas — including platform teams and developers, data teams, and central IT — articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency. Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications, positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences. Run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders. Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists. Compete and win against legacy and cloud-native operational databases by leveraging our compete assets, benchmarks, and customer references. Align to measurable business outcomes such as performance, developer productivity, time-to-market for new features, cost reduction, and simplification of the operational data landscape. Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to shape territory plans, launch plays, and co-selling motions with key ISVs and GSIs. Enable the field by sharing Lakebase best practices, success stories, and sales motions with broader sales teams, helping scale Lakebase proficiency across the organization. What success looks like in this role This role requires the ability to operate across two key motions simultaneously: Establish top strategic focus accounts by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase. Drive longer-term Postgres standardization and migration within Databricks' most strategic accounts. Candidates should demonstrate how they can act as a force multiplier across multiple dimensions of the business. Success in this role requires strength in four areas: Business ownership – Operate at a business-unit level by tracking revenue, pipeline, and key observations, and by identifying areas needing additional focus or support. Strategic account engagement – Partner with account teams to engage priority accounts across the global DB700, driving strategic opportunities from initial engagement through successful outcomes. Field enablement – Build and execute enablement plans that empower AEs and SAs to confidently carry the Lakebase conversation even when the specialist is not present. description: Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. We are looking for an innovative Agentic AI Engineer to join our team. You will build multi-agent ecosystems that are self-directed. These ecosystems will do more than just answer questions. They will collaborate, delegate tasks, and execute complex business processes across the organization. In this role, you will focus on large language models (LLMs), agent orchestration, and A2A integration frameworks to power our intelligent workforce. You will create workflows for multiple agents instead of just focusing on single-agent search or managing the stack. These workflows will enable the agents to communicate with each other, share information, access enterprise tools, and automate tasks from start to finish. Driven by a service-oriented mindset, you will empower internal teams with cutting-edge LLM capabilities while integrating seamlessly with enterprise systems. Are you ready to build the next generation of LLM-powered multi-agent systems that supercharge enterprise productivity? Join us to enable agent-to-agent workflows that turn collective knowledge into instant, coordinated action across Elastic. What You Will Be Doing A2A Architecture & Multi-Agent Orchestration: Design, build, and deploy agent-to-agent (A2A) communication architectures and workflows that enable autonomous agents to collaborate, delegate tasks, and negotiate multi-step business processes. LLM Integration & Tool Calling: Integrate advanced LLMs, both proprietary and open-source, with enterprise APIs. Use tool-calling methods. Connect with third-party SaaS applications for smooth operations. Enterprise Grounding & RAG: Use advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques. Implement strategies that connect enterprise context by using search and vector storage engines. This will ensure that all inter-agent operations are highly accurate and reliable. Scalable Infrastructure & IaC: Provision and manage robust cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) using Terraform to support the high-concurrency demands of LLM inferences and multi-agent coordination. DevOps & Lifecycle Management: Support modern DevOps practices. This includes creating CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, deployment, and versioning. You will also evaluate LLMs and agentic workflows regularly. A2A Security & Governance: Apply strict security and network fundamentals (VPC configurations, secure API gateways, encryption, and IAM controls) to secure inter-agent communication and protect sensitive enterprise data. LLM Observability & Evaluation: Create systems to monitor how multiple agents interact. These systems will help us check model accuracy. They will also help manage token spending and identify model drift or agent loops. Documentation: Keep detailed technical documents for LLM integration protocols. This includes A2A interaction flows and cloud infrastructure deployments. What You Bring Experience with AI-assisted development, code review, test generation, working through unfamiliar code, drafting specifications, summarizing incidents, and accelerating research. Experience in shipping features covering full stack from design, build, test and deploy across the stack from database and portal through APIs, backend services, and the data pipeline LLM & GenAI Expertise: Deep experience integrating, fine-tuning, and optimizing foundation models (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models), including expertise in prompt engineering, tool calling, and structured outputs. Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Protocols: Proven success building multi-agent systems, inter-agent messaging pipelines, state management frameworks, and dynamic task delegation protocols. Agentic Frameworks: Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph , LangChain , AutoGen , etc. along with tracing platforms like LangSmith . Market Trends & Interoperability: Strong understanding of emerging AI interoperability standards, such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and open multi-agent communication specifications. Programming: Contribute production code to our product code base using ReactJS / NodeJS/Java/Spring, our Kotlin Multiplatform SDK and its native layers, Angular/TypeScript Portal and JavaScript Web SDK, NoSQL data modeling, streaming and messaging/queueing technologies. Enterprise Grounding & Vector Search: Practical knowledge of RAG patterns, vector databases, hybrid search architectures, and context management strategies. DevOps & Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Hands-on experience with DevOps practices and infrastructure automation using Terraform, Docker, and Kubernetes for scalable AI deployments. Security & Network Fundamentals: Strong knowledge of secure cloud architectures, zero-trust network design, private endpoints, and identity management (OAuth, SAML, IAM) for secure A2A interactions. LLM Observability & Evaluation: Experience setting up observability frameworks (logging, distributed tracing, and metrics) to track non-deterministic multi-agent workflows, token costs, and LLM output quality. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI. What is The Role This role focuses on driving business intelligence and performance optimization across regional marketing initiatives by leveraging existing enterprise data products and reports developed by our core internal team. Rather than building new reporting infrastructure, this individual will serve as the expert user of established dashboards—analyzing results, diagnosing anomalies, and translating existing data into strategic insights. This position partners closely with regional marketing leaders to review performance and conduct ad-hoc deep-dive analyses that support marketing effectiveness , campaign ROI, and strategic decision-making. What You Will Be Doing Analyze global and regional marketing results using existing core dashboards and reports to identify underlying performance trends, growth drivers, and shifting data patterns. Conduct ad-hoc deep-dive analyses using established data products to independently diagnose performance anomalies, tracking down the root causes of unexpected traffic spikes or pipeline drops. Partner directly with regional marketing teams to build deep local business context, scope analytical requests, and translate standard dashboard data into actionable performance insights. Synthesize complex datasets from existing reports into clear summaries, providing regional leadership with strategic recommendations rather than just surface-level data tracking. Bridge the gap between data and strategy by proactively guiding cross-functional marketing partners on how to interpret existing dashboards to inform daily budget and campaign decisions. Act as the expert user and champion of core reporting tools, funneling regional user requirements and data gaps back to the core internal dashboard-development team. Audit regional performance metrics to ensure lead flow metrics, multi-touch attribution models, and conversion velocity data are accurately interpreted by stakeholders. Communicate performance findings and diagnostic insights clearly to stakeholders across varying levels of technical and business fluency. What You Bring Solid business acumen with a deep understanding of B2B marketing funnels, lead lifecycles, and pipeline mechanics. Collaborative communication style with the confidence to facilitate stakeholder meetings, ask critical probing questions, and constructively challenge business assumptions. Advanced diagnostic outlook with a proven ability to interpret patterns or anomalies in existing reports and form testable hypotheses. Proactive and self-motivated problem-solver comfortable navigating ambiguous business requests and evolving regional execution models. Data storytelling capability with a track record of translating analytical charts into simple, high-impact business narratives. 3–5 years of experience in marketing analytics, business intelligence, strategy consulting, or a highly analytical marketing operations role. Proficient in dashboard interpretation skills, with deep experience navigating and extracting insights from enterprise BI tools (such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker). Analytical skills including intermediate Excel/Google Sheets proficiency to manipulate, pivot, and model data extracted from existing reporting systems. Hands-on experience navigating data models and pulling native reports within CRMs (Salesforce preferred) and major marketing automation platforms (Marketo preferred). About the team
The Core Infrastructure team builds the platforms and systems that power everything at Fam, from real-time app experiences to high-volume payments. It operates as a small, high-leverage team with deep ownership. Every service at Fam runs on the platform this team builds, so it cares obsessively about system fundamentals, operational excellence, and mechanical sympathy.
What our systems process
1 Billion+ API requests per day powering ~10M daily transactions for 10M+ users at 20,000+ RPS.
470+ node Kubernetes cluster (~2,500 vCPUs and ~8 TiB RAM) under active orchestration.
Dynamic, multi-dimensional auto-scaling powered by 195+ HPAs paired with Karpenter.
12+ TB of active transactional data (and counting) across our high-throughput database clusters.
Event Streaming - 400+ topics, and 3,800+ partitions at ~46,700 messages/sec
Our Next Chapter
While our core systems already handle massive scale, our next vision as a team is to turn infrastructure into a frictionless platform discipline.
We are building towards a world where internal engineering teams consume platform primitives compute, storage, and event streams via self-serve contracts without waiting on us. We're also laying the groundwork for AI-native platform operations, developing agent plane and agent skills so agents can safely interact & operate infrastructure primitives alongside our team. We look to the CNCF landscape for best-in-class tools our systems, with a long-term commitment to contributing back to open source.

Build and extend fine-grained permissions for tokens and roles so additional resources have permission coverage consistent with the established catalog. Extend and fix authorization enforcement so GraphQL and the REST API enforce the intended permissions consistently. Make incremental refactors to long-lived policy code without changing behavior for existing customers. Investigate and fix reliability, performance, and security issues so affected permission checks return the expected results without regressions. Work with the authentication, platform, and artificial intelligence (AI) teams to document interface contracts that keep permission checks consistent as authorization moves toward a shared service. An overview of this role We're looking for an Intermediate Site Reliability Engineer to join the Cells Infrastructure team in GitLab's Scale & Architecture organization. In this role, you'll help build and operate Cells, the architecture that lets GitLab.com scale horizontally. Cells splits GitLab.com into many independent units, each with its own application and data stack, behind a shared routing layer. This is a build-it-and-run-it role. You'll provision cells, route traffic to them, deploy them safely, and keep them reliable in production. You'll also help move customer organizations onto Cells, one of GitLab's most important scaling initiatives. What you'll do Operate Cells in production: join the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, lead post-incident reviews, and drive corrective actions to completion. Define and monitor service level objectives (SLOs) for routing and cell health, and build the dashboards, alerts, and runbooks behind them. Provision and operate cell infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Kubernetes, networking, Identity and Access Management (IAM), PostgreSQL, Redis, and object storage. Develop infrastructure as code with Terraform, Helm, and GitOps tooling such as Argo CD. Operate and extend the global routing layer, built on Cloudflare Workers, Envoy, and a Go service backed by Cloud Spanner, and expand routing to more protocols and services. Improve the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines behind ring-based deployments, covering promotion, database migrations, quality assurance validation, and rollback. Support organization migrations by preparing destination cells and helping with dry runs and production cutovers. Work with product teams to make their services cell-compatible, and write documentation so others can operate Cells with confidence. Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it. What you'll bring Professional experience running production infrastructure at scale on AWS, GCP, or both, including Kubernetes, along with strong Terraform and Helm skills. Proficiency in Go, or strong experience in another systems language and willingness to work in Go daily. Solid grounding in site reliability engineering (SRE) best practices: SLOs and error budgets, blameless post-incident reviews, reducing toil through automation, capacity planning, and designing for graceful degradation. Experience owning services in production, including on-call, incident response, and monitoring with tools such as Prometheus and Grafana. Practical knowledge of progressive delivery: how to roll changes safely across a fleet and how to roll them back. A strong understanding of distributed-systems fundamentals, such as request routing, proxies, consistency, and failure domains. Experience working effectively in distributed, all-remote teams: you default to asynchronous, written-first communication, document decisions in issues and merge requests, hand off work cleanly across time zones, and stay transparent about progress and blockers. Experience with Cloudflare, Spanner, Argo CD, TypeScript, or operating GitLab at scale is a plus, not a requirement. About the team Every team in our organization owns its services end to end, from design through on-call.We own the control plane that tracks cells and decides where each request belongs, and keep the fleet in step with GitLab's release cadence.We work closely with delivery, database, migration, and product teams across GitLab. Feature teams own how their services behave on the platform; we own the underlying infrastructure.We're an all-remote, asynchronous team. We make decisions in GitLab issues, use directly responsible individuals (DRIs) to own technical direction, demo our work weekly, and use AI-assisted workflows every day. title: Solution Engineer (Post-sales)
description:
About Hevo
DoorDash, Footlocker, Arhaus, Santander, and thousands of other data-driven companies have one thing in common. They all use Hevo Data’s fully managed Automated Pipelines to consolidate their data from multiple sources like Databases, Marketing Applications, Cloud Storage, SDKs, Streaming Services, etc. 
We are a San Francisco, Bangalore, and Pune-based company with 2000+ customers spread across 45+ countries in e-commerce, financial technology, and healthcare. Strongly backed by marquee investors like Sequoia Capital, we have raised $42 Million to date and are looking forward to our next phase of hyper-growth!
Why do we exist?
At Hevo, our mission is to enable every company to be data-driven. We started on this journey 9 years back, and as the first step in this direction, we built our first product – “Data Pipeline” or simply “Pipeline”.
Hevo Pipeline is a no-code platform that helps companies connect all their sources of data within the company to get a unified view of their business. The platform offers integrations with 150+ data sources such as Databases, SaaS applications, Advertising Channels, etc.
Today, we enable close to 2000 companies across more than 40+ countries to be more data-driven. Our aim is to make the technology so simple that anyone should be able to solve their data problems and not be limited due to their lack of technical skills.
The Role
We are growing into mid-market and enterprise accounts where the technical bar - and the stakes - are higher. To win and retain these customers, we are building the technical depth in our post-sale motion to match.
Enterprise buyers are not just buying a product. They are making architectural decisions. The CTOs, data architects, and engineering leads we work with at this level need a technical counterpart. 
As a Solution Engineer, you are that person. You are not the first point of contact, and you are not handling tickets. 
You are the expert our Account Managers bring in when a customer conversation goes beyond relationship management - a quarterly architecture review, a complex integration challenge, a strategic expansion decision, or simply when a CTO wants to talk to someone who really knows data.
What You Will Do
Be the senior technical specialist that Account Managers call on for complex customer conversations - architecture reviews, expansion discussions, and senior-level technical engagements.
Engage credibly with CTOs, senior engineers, and data architects as a genuine thought partner: understand their architecture, challenge assumptions, co-design pipelines, and offer a credible point of view.
Lead technical discovery and solution design for enterprise customers evaluating new use cases, migrations, or architectural changes involving Hevo.
Translate complex customer requirements into actionable guidance - both for the customer and, where needed, and for Hevo's internal engineering team.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
About the role

This role is a strong fit for data engineers with 2 to 4 years of experience who want to take their technical depth into a customer-facing role. If you have spent the last few years building pipelines, working with cloud warehouses, and solving real data problems, but you are starting to wonder what comes next, this is worth a closer look.

In this role, you will work directly with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs at companies evaluating Hevo across the US, Europe, Southeast Asia, and ANZ. You will help them design the right data architecture, walk them through trade-offs, and earn the technical trust that turns an evaluation into a partnership. You will do this independently, often as the sole technical person on the call. There is no senior SE in the background. You need to walk into a Zoom with a VP of Data Engineering at a US fintech or a Head of Analytics at a European e-commerce company, earn their technical respect in the first five minutes, and hold it for the rest of the engagement.

The technical depth you have built does not go away. It gets applied to a much wider set of problems, a much larger audience, and a global stage.

Hevo runs real-time data pipelines from 150+ sources into modern warehouses for over 1,000 companies, including DoorDash and Shopify. You will be the person customers rely on to make sure Hevo fits their stack, their scale, and their goals.


Why this role is worth considering

A. You move from building pipelines to shaping data strategy

In your current role, you build what is specified. In this role, you sit with senior data leaders and help them decide what to build across the modern data stack. Your existing experience in CDC, warehouse design, and pipeline reliability becomes the foundation for higher-leverage work.

B. You get global exposure that is hard to find elsewhere

You will be in regular technical conversations with Heads of Data and CTOs at fast-growing companies across North America, Europe, and beyond. You will run discovery, defend architecture choices, and present in rooms where decisions get made. This is rare exposure for someone at the 2 to 4 year mark, and almost unheard of from Bangalore.

C. Your technical depth stays central

This is not a pivot away from engineering. Everything you know about Postgres, CDC, Kafka, dbt, Snowflake, and pipeline reliability gets used every day. The difference is that your technical opinion shapes the customer’s architecture instead of staying inside a Jira ticket.

D. The career path is real

Strong performers in this role grow into senior individual contributor roles, lead the function, or move into product, customer success leadership, or founding-engineer roles at their next company. The optionality this role builds is significant.

What you will do

Run technical discovery calls with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs to understand their stack, pain points, and constraints. These are global conversation

title: Strategy & Ops (Founder's Office)
description:
Read this part first
Experience: 2 to 8 years
Location: HSR Layout, BLR
Most Strategy and Operations roles quietly turn into reporting jobs. You pull the numbers, format the decks, and remind people about deadlines. This is not that role.
This is the role for someone who wants to learn, at close range, how a fast growing company actually plans, prioritizes, and executes. You will work directly with the CEO and the leadership team on the problems that cut across functions, the ones no single team can solve alone. Your job is to turn ambiguity into a plan, and a plan into results.
For the right person, this also happens to be one of the best leadership educations available anywhere. People who do this job well at Hevo build the instincts of a real operator, and many go on to run things. But the simplest reason to take it is this: you get to work on what matters most, alongside the people who decide it.
What you will own:
1. The operational rhythm of the whole company. You will work with the CEO to keep the entire machine moving across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Engineering, HR, Solutions, and Support. You will run the OKR process with the leadership team, drive quarterly planning and goal setting, and track delivery so nothing important slips. You will be the person who can tell, on any given day, how healthy the organization really is and where attention is needed next.
2. The strategic projects that move the needle. You will partner with the CEO and other leaders to spot the initiatives that genuinely change the trajectory of the business, then own them end to end until they are big enough to stand on their own and get handed to a dedicated team. These are the bets that matter most, and you will be trusted to carry them.
3. Cross functional execution and alignment. You will be the connective tissue across functions, driving communication so the company moves as one. You will be a real thought partner to leadership on vision, priorities, and the hard tradeoffs. You will manage relationships with stakeholders inside and outside the company, and when needed, represent leadership in reviews.

title: AM/M - Risk Analytics - User Lending
description:
About the Team
Would you like to be part of creating a unicorn within a unicorn? Solve some of the biggest challenges facing financial inclusion of Bharat? Well, then here's your chance!
Financial Services (FS) is one of the biggest new bets we are taking at Meesho on the next 10x horizon opportunity for us. Just as Ant Financial did for Alibaba, and Mercado Pago did for Mercado Libre, our vision is to build financial services for Meesho, becoming our key growth and revenue driver.
We have found our Product-Market Fit, built and proved 0-1 and 1-10 journeys. Now looking for someone who can be the founding member of a 10-100-1000 journey, and this is possibly one of the most exciting and enriching experiences one could consider in their career.
About the Role
Meesho FS runs two lines of business: SME Lending, which offers Business Loans, and User Lending, which offers BNPL and Personal Loans (PL). 
User Lending is now our primary focus in this phase of our FS journey. We have 274Mn ATU, and risk management is at the core of building any sustainable credit business at scale - our being a captive audience means both Growth and Risk are an outcome of underwriting, which is owned by the Risk team.
Herein also lies one of our biggest challenges: how do we assess the risk of borrowers without any credit history or income data? How can we leverage alternative information to better profile borrowers? How can we leverage our platform uniquely to create a sustained competitive advantage?
This person will be responsible for driving the analytics behind these questions for User Lending - creating analytical frameworks, developing high quality analysis, driving insights and actions, and recommending policy decisions, across a well-established BNPL portfolio and a Personal Loans portfolio that is still scaling.
Your role will focus on:
Owning the risk for one or more segments of the portfolio while maintaining a healthy growth.
Analyzing credit policies using Meesho platform data, bureau data, SMS data, and other alternate data.
Creating policies, scorecards and models (Application Score, B-Score, Collection Scores) for BNPL and PL.
Designing experiments to test cohort behaviour, experimental policies, and new opportunities for growth.
Identifying pockets of risk within the portfolio that don't make sense, and identifying leading indicators / EWS.
Automating reporting and tracking of the portfolio at multiple levels - Ops performance measures, key performance indicators, and their drivers.
Refining credit policies based on data and creating new policies for unexplored segments, including building day-1 policies for Personal Loans as the product scales.
Configuring and testing rules in the real-time Business Rule Engine (BRE), and working with the Bureau Feature Store to define new underwriting features.

title: Data Scientist III (Team- Valmo)
description:
About us
Meesho - Every story here begins with a spark of ambition and a touch of entrepreneurial magic. We're not just a platform — we're your partner in transforming dreams into reality.
Our Mission
Democratising internet commerce for everyone - Meesho started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for the next billion Indian consumers and enable small businesses to succeed online. We provide sellers with a range of industry-first benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping costs, growing their business by tapping the company's massive customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics at cost through third-party logistics providers and our in-house logistics arm Valmo, in an 'Everyday Low Cost' channel for sellers.
Affordable, relatable merchandise mirroring local markets has helped us make inroads with first-time internet users in the country. We cater to an underserved and unique customer base and cover every serviceable pincode in the country. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have enabled us to become the first Indian horizontal e-commerce company.
Know more about Meesho here: https://www.meesho.io/
About Valmo and the Data Science Team
Valmo is Meesho's own logistics arm, built to give sellers and customers cutting-edge, low-cost logistics and supply chain support. Supply Chain Network Optimization sits at the heart of the Valmo Data Science team: we design and plan the network that moves Valmo's shipments every day, from first-mile pickup through sort centres and line haul to last-mile delivery. We use OR, MILP, stochastic optimisation, simulation, ML and DL across network design, first/middle/last-mile optimisation, capacity planning and delivery promise, and we build for the long term, not just today's problems. This role is for someone ready to execute at speed, with a growth mindset, to build and scale these models.
 About the Role
As a Data Scientist 3(Operations Research), you will own a workstream within Valmo network design — not just a model. You will be accountable for the North Star Metric of that workstream (cost per shipment, end-to-end shipment speed, network capacity utilisation, on-time delivery, delivery promise), set its OR/ML roadmap, and mentor DS1s and DS2s in delivering it. You will take ambiguous, loosely-defined business problems, decide which ones are worth solving, formulate them mathematically, and ship optimization systems that run Valmo's network every day. Workstreams span network design, routing and scheduling across the first, middle and last mile.

title: AI Product Engineer
description:
Role Overview
We are transitioning our organization to an AI-first operational model. We are seeking an AI Product Engineer to architect and build the company’s central intelligence engine.
In this role, you will be the primary builder of automated intelligence systems—tools that not only retrieve insights but actively trigger workflows, and synthesize strategic intel across our entire business landscape.
Role Profile
This is a high-impact, hands-on engineering role requiring a convergence of three distinct skill sets:
Software Engineering (50%): Building scalable middleware, API integrations, and production-grade applications that connect our data stack to business tools (CRM, Marketing Automation, Support/Ticketing).
AI Engineering (30%): Implementing Agentic workflows, RAG architectures, and LLMs to process unstructured data at scale.
Data Analytics (20%): Leveraging SQL and B2B SaaS metrics to ensure all automation is grounded in accurate, governed data.
Key Responsibilities
1. Building the "Enterprise Brain" (Architecture & Integration)
Develop a unified intelligence layer that ingests signals from disparate sources (Product Telemetry, CRM, Call Transcripts, Marketing inputs) and processes them into actionable outputs.
Build robust integrations/webhooks to push AI-generated insights directly into workflow tools (e.g., pushing "Churn Risk" alerts into Salesforce
2. AI Logic & Agent Implementation
Architect "Agentic" workflows where LLMs are granted permission to perform tasks 
Implement advanced RAG to ground AI outputs in company documentation, historical data, and strategic context.
Ensure rigorous evaluation and guardrails for non-deterministic models to prevent "hallucinations" in critical business workflows.
3. Data Engineering & Governance
Collaborate with Analytics Engineers to ensure the underlying data pipelines support real-time or near-real-time AI applications.
Maintain security and privacy standards, ensuring that AI agents respect data access permissions across different departments.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Software Engineering: 3+ years of experience in Python development, with strong proficiency in API development (FastAPI/Django) and building integrations between SaaS platforms.
AI/ML Application: Proven experience building applications using LLM APIs and orchestration frameworks, Experience with "Agent" concepts.
Data Proficiency: Strong SQL skills and familiarity with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake/BigQuery).
Preferred Qualifications:
Business Systems Knowledge: Experience working with APIs for major B2B tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Jira, Marketo).
Workflow Automation: Experience with tools like Airflow, Zapier/Make (advanced usage), or custom workflow engines.
B2B Domain Expertise: Understanding of the interplay between Sales, Product, and Customer Success.
Competencies
The "Builder" Mindset: You are

title: Software Engineer - UI Test
description: ABOUT THE TEAM The mission of the UI Test team is to ensure best-in-class UI experience for Rubrik products. The team accomplishes this by testing and automating customer workflows, providing UI automation infrastructure for end to end validation and benchmarking, checking usability and user experience and consistency across the features and products. Key stakeholders are product component teams, product management, release managers and end customers. The key responsibilities of the team include qualifying new features for production release and leading UI release regression qualification across Rubrik's on-prem and cloud products. We do manual and automated testing, including developing the test infrastructure needed. We build and use AI-native skills that automate the entire testing lifecycle, starting from generating the UI test plan to executing them in real environments. ABOUT THE JOB UI Test team responsibilities: Feature qualification: The UI Test team qualifies new features from the end-user point of view (UI) for all Rubrik products before rolling out to production. We make sure every feature adheres to the quality standards and integrates well with the rest of the product. Maintains high quality bar in test processes, strategy and test execution. Release regression testing: All released features are regression tested in every release, on a cadence that depends on the product, with both manual and automated UI testing. Automation: New features enter the automation backlog after release and are picked up by priority. UI Automation using browser automation frameworks such as Playwright. Infrastructure automation/maintenance using Python. Automated test pipelines in a CI/CD system Each phase of the testing life cycle is getting automated. Using AI-assisted tooling to generate test cases from product artifacts, execute them against real environments to reduce manual qualification effort. QUALIFICATIONS: Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field 5-8 years of experience in software testing, UI testing and automation Solid understanding on data protection, storage, security, virtualization, databases, cloud, kubernetes and generative AI Familiarity with UI performance and accessibility testing. Working knowledge of microservices, API, cloud native architectures and how to test them Experience with Cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), cybersecurity, AI resilience. A cloud certification is an advantage. Deep experience in driving complete test life cycle (test planning, execution, automation) and release qualification. Test management using TestRail or equivalent is a plus. Good hands-on experience programming in Python or equivalent and UI automation using TestIM, Selenium, Playwright or equivalent. JavaScript/TypeScript knowledge is a plus. Hands-on experience using AI coding or testing assistants in test authoring, debugging or automation, and sound judgment about the quality of their output. Hands on experience in creating, triaging and maintaining automated test pipeline using Jenkins, GitHub or similar CI/CD tools Strong written and verbal communication, including documentation that others can pick up without a handoff. Key differentiating factors: Due to the unique placement of the team, it is exposed to multiple key technologies of Rubrik products. This opportunity is not just another manual testing or automation role, key factor is the exposure and opportunity to learn core technologies of data protection, storage, security, anti ransomware, Virtualization(Hyper-V, VMware), Databases (SQL, Oracle, Mongo, DB2), cloud technologies (Azure, Google, AWS), Kubernetes, and cutting edge features involving Generative AI etc. Exposure to automated infrastructure creation and clean up on various platforms like VMware, Azure, AWS etc. Hands-on work with AI-based tools for test authoring, execution and automation. Automation using latest AI based tools Every team member is given equal opportunity to lead releases on a rotational basis giving them opportunities to learn the release process and develop their leadership skills. Ownership opportunities: every member in the team irrespective of the designation has end-end ownership right from PRD review, test case development, interaction with key stakeholders( like Product manager, program managers, component managers and developers), execution and reporting Opportunity to become a quality advocate for the assigned component and product, and develop expertise in the assigned areas. title: Business Analyst - NPI Operations
description: About the team: The CPQ & NPI Operations team sits within Product Operations and is at the core of how we bring new products to market and optimise our quote-to-cash process. We don’t just operationalise new SKUs—we ensure seamless integration of next-generation quoting tools, drive automation, and enhance the overall sales experience. We partner across Product, Engineering, Sales, Deal Desk, and Finance to streamline how products are configured, quoted, sold, and provisioned. Our team ensures that our CPQ and Product Master tools remain high-performing, scalable systems—balancing automation, policy enforcement, and ease of use without overloading it with unnecessary complexity. About the role: We are seeking a highly driven, enterprising individual with exceptional communication skills to join our NPI Operations team and help operationalise our products in our quote-to-cash processes. In this full-time hybrid role, you’ll use your NPI and CPQ knowledge to translate strategy into operational reality: aligning with cross-functional partners on process and policy, compiling requirements, and delivering efficient, scalable solutions from New Product Introduction (NPI) through End of Life (EOL). What you'll do: Support GTM initiatives and new product launches; be accountable for CPQ and NPI deliverables that drive product growth and improve sales productivity. Own the NPI Operations ticket queue and dashboards: triage, assign, track, and follow up to meet SLAs and prevent escalations; balance day-to-day support with small to medium projects. Regularly compile reports and provide clear status updates; communicate timelines, risks, and decisions to stakeholders. Deliver NPI releases and bug fixes based on priority; execute predefined processes independently and escalate for support or visibility when appropriate. Lead CPQ and NPI enhancements and initiatives end-to-end: requirements analysis, consensus-building, solution design, testing, documentation, training, and launch. Partner closely with IT and cross-functional teams to design scalable, agile solutions and drive timely delivery through effective coordination and communication. Maintain the product master and ensure SKU configuration integrity across PDM and CPQ environments; recommend improvements grounded in best practices. Analyse and optimise CPQ and NPI processes to drive efficiency and scalability; assess upstream/downstream impacts across PDM, CPQ, billing, and renewals. Work across the full quote-to-cash lifecycle—from packaging, pricing, and selling to growth, retention, and EOL transitions—to drive cross-functional alignment. Create, maintain, and deliver training and documentation for all new implementations to drive adoption and ensure stakeholders are enabled as products and processes roll out. Mentor junior analysts on CPQ/NPI processes and best practices. Experience you'll need: Required: 8+ years in a Business Analyst or operations role, preferably in a SaaS environment 6+ years of hands-on experience in CPQ or other quote-to-cash system Track record contributing to go-to-market initiatives in high-growth, scaling organisations; proven ability to translate strategy into executable plans Self-starter & Results-Driven: demonstrates a high level of productivity with minimal oversight; takes ownership, shows initiative, and proactively drives solutions to completion Strategic thinker: evaluate things holistically and for the long term, make decisions using a strong blend of technical chops, risk assessment, and understanding of business needs and priorities Excellent communication and follow-up skills; transparency, and the ability to synthesise information into a clear, digestible format for business operations teams Adept collaboration skills; Comfort working cross-functionally and learning new domains quickly; technical fluency in systems and data concepts; ability to influence without formal authority Strong analytical skills; able to assess CPQ and downstream impacts, analyse data to identify issues, and recommend solutions. Hands-on experience with operational tools and systems (e.g., Salesforce, Jira); familiarity with quoting, SKU configuration, and the product development lifecycle. High-energy, company first, positive attitude: Passionate and motivated to make a massive impact and work hard in a fast-paced environment You are detail-oriented, leverage your resources, and get things done on time with quality results Preferred: Experience delivering NPI releases, complex SKU updates, and changes that span multiple workstreams. SFDC administration experience and/or Salesforce certifications. Familiarity with AI concepts, ideally as applied to the Sales function, is a plus. Working Hours: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST. title: Database Reliability Engineer/Database Engineer (Rubrik Security Cloud Platform)
description: About the Role We are seeking an experienced Database Reliability Engineer to own the reliability, performance, and scalability of our end-to-end database infrastructure. You will manage both our low-latency transactional engines and our real-time analytical/lakehouse storage systems. You will bridge systems engineering, database internals, and automation to maintain rock-solid data integrity, low query latency, and high availability across the entire data lifecycle. What you'll do Performance & Query Optimization: Diagnose and resolve latency regressions, lock/latch contention, index strategies, and memory/disk bottlenecks across both row-oriented and columnar engines. Disaster Recovery & Data Integrity: Ensure strict RTO/RPO adherence, automated backup validation, PITR (point-in-time recovery), and data consistency across transactional and analytical stores. Storage Optimization & Compaction: Manage compaction policies, partition strategies, file sizing, and storage tiering to minimize storage costs and read amplification. Transactional Reliability & Operations: Manage HA, automated failover, replication topology, and zero-downtime maintenance for production RDBMS clusters. Analytical Storage Infrastructure: Maintain, scale, and optimize real-time analytical engines (ClickHouse) and lakehouse formats/engines (Apache Iceberg, BigQuery). Infrastructure as Code & Observability: Build declarative automation for cluster provisioning, schema migrations, and metric alerting (Prometheus, PromQL, Grafana) Experience you'll need Database Internals & RDBMS Fundamentals: Deep understanding of ACID guarantees, WAL, checkpointing, and recovery mechanics (e.g., ARIES-style recovery). Comprehensive grasp of concurrency control, transaction isolation levels, lock protocols (2PL, deadlocks), and MVCC architectures. Deep knowledge of storage structures: B+ Trees, LSM-Trees, and columnar storage layouts (e.g., Parquet, ORC, ClickHouse Wide/Compact formats). Operational Database Experience: 4+ years running production database infrastructure, with deep expertise in [PostgreSQL / MySQL]. Experience optimizing and managing cost/quotas in Google Cloud BigQuery (partitioning, clustering, reservation slots). Experience with OLAP DB like: ClickHouse, BQ Systems & Kernel Engineering: Strong Linux fundamentals: I/O subsystems, page cache vs. engine buffer pools, disk alignment, asynchronous I/O, and memory management. Automation & Software Engineering: Using Python or Go for building database automation, operators, and CLI tooling. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and container orchestration. Preferred skills and qualifications Hands-on administration and performance tuning of ClickHouse (cluster topologies, ZooKeeper/Keeper coordination, MergeTree engine family, mutations, and compaction). Experience with change data capture (CDC) pipelines (e.g., Debezium, Kafka) feeding transactional updates into ClickHouse/Iceberg. Experience managing lakehouse storage patterns using Apache Iceberg (metadata management, snapshot expiration, file compaction/orphan cleanup). Experience with automated schema migration tools (e.g., gh-ost, Liquibase, Bytebase). Familiarity with distributed consensus engines ( ClickHouse Keeper,Raft, Paxos). #LI-PM2 Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. title: Legal Counsel
description: Legal Counsel, Channels Bangalore, India preferred (Hybrid in office 2 days a week) | Open to fully remote within India for the right candidate About Our Team The Rubrik Commercial Legal Team manages Rubrik's global commercial contracts and revenue-related legal matters. Within Commercial Legal, the Channels & Alliances legal team supports Rubrik's partner ecosystem: the distributors, resellers, managed service providers, global and regional system integrators, and alliance partners through which Rubrik sells its data security and cyber resilience products worldwide. Rubrik goes to market primarily through a two-tier channel: Rubrik sells to a Distributor, the Distributor sells to a Reseller, and the Reseller sells to the end Customer. This role is the day-to-day legal partner for that business unit. You will be the first point of contact for the Channels organization on reseller and distributor agreements, amendments and partner program requests, keeping deals moving and partners compliant. You will join a small, collaborative team and work alongside a Channels Legal Counsel peer, reporting to the Director of Legal who leads Channels & Alliances, Marketplaces and Inbound Licensing. This is a hands-on role for an attorney who already works in the channel world, enjoys negotiating with partners and wants to be a trusted advisor to a fast-moving sales organization. Where You Can Make an Impact Own day-to-day channel contracting: Draft, review and negotiate reseller agreements, distributor agreements, amendments, adoption agreements for partner affiliates, resale enablement amendments and other documents partners need to resell Rubrik's SaaS and subscription products. Live in the two-tier channel model: Apply a deep working knowledge of Rubrik's go-to-market: Rubrik sells to a Distributor, who sells to a Reseller, who sells to the end Customer. Understand how order flow, pricing and discounts, deal registration, flow-down terms and end-user agreements work across each tier, and spot when a request breaks the model. Be the front door for the Channels organization: Manage the channel contract-request intake queue. Triage, prioritize and route incoming requests, resolve routine matters yourself and escalate exceptions with a clear recommendation. Support the Partner Program: Advise Partner Programs and Partner Operations on partner program requests, program terms and conditions, tier and status changes, program exceptions, incentive and referral arrangements, and partner onboarding and offboarding. Advise channel leaders and account managers: Act as a trusted advisor to Channel Account Managers, Distribution leaders, Alliances and the Channels Global Partner Organization. Answer their questions with practical, business-ready guidance and help them close deals on standard terms. Negotiate directly with partners: Lead negotiations and calls with partner legal, procurement and business teams. Hold Rubrik's standard positions, use approved fallbacks and know when to escalate. Build and maintain templates and playbooks: Create and update channel agreement templates, amendment forms, negotiation playbooks, fallback positions, FAQs and training so the ecosystem stays on standard terms and the business can self-serve. Drive deals to signature: Coordinate internal approvals, signature requests and e-signature execution, and work with Partner Operations and Deal Desk so executed agreements are recorded correctly in Salesforce and partners can transact. Apply a compliance and competition lens: Identify and escalate antitrust and competition law issues common to distribution (resale price maintenance, dual distribution, territorial and customer restrictions, exclusivity), as well as anti-corruption, sanctions and export, and public-sector procurement issues. Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with Commercial Legal, Privacy, Security, Revenue, Tax, Deal Desk and Partner Operations to deliver consistent answers and keep channel terms aligned with Rubrik's customer-facing terms. Support a global channel: Work IST business hours while supporting partners and stakeholders worldwide, with a primary focus on APAC and EMEA and meaningful AMER coverage. Flex your hours during quarter-end and other peak periods to support AMER deals. Improve how we work: Spot repeat questions and bottlenecks, propose process and template fixes, and use technology (including AI tools) to speed up routine work. Ideal Background Licensed attorney in India (LL.B. and enrolled with a State Bar Council) with 3 to 6 years of post-qualification experience, including meaningful in-house experience at a technology or SaaS company. Currently working in a channel, partner or distribution contracting role. You negotiate reseller and distributor agreements today and understand two-tier distribution and how SaaS is resold through partners. Comfortable negotiating directly with partner legal and procurement teams and advising business stakeholders without a safety net. Working knowledge of partner programs, deal registration, subscription and SaaS commercial models, and how channel terms interact with end-customer terms. Awareness of competition and compliance issues in distribution relationships and of anti-bribery and anti-corruption rules that apply to selling through partners. Excellent English drafting and communication skills. You write clearly, explain risk in business terms and give a recommendation, not a menu. Organized and reliable in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment. You prioritize well, track your queue and close the loop. Independent, proactive and business-oriented, with sound judgment about what to decide and what to escalate. The Identity Resilience team is Rubrik’s fastest-growing business unit, operating with a high-velocity "0-to-1" charter. Today, modern cyberattacks almost exclusively weaponize identity systems. When identity fails, the entire enterprise halts. Our mission is to ensure enterprise identity environments are secure, observable, compliant, and instantly recoverable. We are looking for a strategically sharp, technical, and execution-minded Product Management Intern for a high-impact 2-month internship based in Bengaluru. What You’ll Do (2-Month Charter) Market Landscape & Threat Vector Analysis: Benchmark the enterprise identity attack surface across hybrid environments. Map emerging threat vectors to potential resilience and recovery capabilities. Customer Discovery & Pain Point Synthesis: Work alongside PM and GTM mentors to analyze customer requirements, telemetry data, and enterprise security frameworks to pinpoint the highest-friction operational gaps for Security and IAM teams. Author a high-quality Product Requirement Document (PRD) balancing enterprise-grade depth with Rubrik’s trademark simplicity. Systems & Security Thinking: An understanding of enterprise software fundamentals; familiarity with core identity concepts is an advantage. Problem Solving: Comfort with ambiguity, structured thinking, and the ability to break complex, undefined problems into crisp, actionable requirements. title: Security Engineer - Identity and Access
description: About the team The Information Security organization advances the overall state of security at Rubrik through purposeful initiatives and coordination of large security projects. Information Security builds technologies, tools, and processes to better enable teams at Rubrik to develop secure software and protect data and systems with appropriate security controls. Information Security also develops systems to monitor and respond to attacks against our systems, provides awareness education to teams on security best practices for data protection, and ensures data sharing relationships with third parties in order to securely protect Rubrik information.3 About the role We are looking for an experienced and technically deep Identity and Access Management (IAM) Engineer to execute technical strategy across our entire Identity and Access Security management program. This domain spans a broad and increasingly complex set of disciplines, including Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Access Management, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Non-Human Identity (NHI) security, and the emerging space of Agentic Identity security. This is fundamentally a hands-on role. You will be expected to personally design systems from the ground up and build automation that scales across a large and diverse application portfolio. At the same time, this role carries significant cross-functional weight: you will be partnering closely and continuously with Information Security, IT, Engineering and the many application-owning teams distributed across the company, driving the identity security initiatives in alignment with the overall business objectives. What you'll do Solution Design Design and build IAM solutions — including configurations, integrations, and workflows — that align with evolving business requirements, security policies and regulatory requirements (eg., SOX, GDPR). Application Onboarding & Integration Lead the onboarding of applications into IAM platforms, integrating across diverse systems including major cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and in-house systems. Build automation and policy-as-code frameworks Manage identity access policies as versioned, auditable code — using source control, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code to automate identity and access management changes instead of manual, ticket-driven processes. Deepen identity governance platform integrations Build and extend automated provisioning/deprovisioning, entitlement aggregation, and access certification workflows across the application portfolio. Privileged Access Management Design privileged access models across applications and endpoints — including session management and just-in-time elevation — to minimize standing access without slowing teams down. Non-human/Agentic identity governance Build inventory, risk-scoring, runtime policy enforcement and remediation tooling for service accounts, API keys, workload identities, AI agents etc IAM Platform Auditing & Posture Management Review and audit identity and access management platforms to identify security misconfigurations, strengthen security policies, and enforce industry best practices. Incident Response & Forensics Support Provide subject matter expertise during security incidents to support investigations into identity and access related events. On-Call Coverage & Escalations Engage in on-call rotations and provide technical escalation support outside standard business hours. Technical governance and design reviews Enforce technical standards across the team, evaluate identity related design proposals, and serve as the main escalation point for complex identity security decisions and integration challenges Experience you'll need Minimum of 6 years of experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM), with deep hands-on experience implementing and managing IAM solutions within leading cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Proficiency with modern identity platforms (e.g., SailPoint, Okta, CyberArk, or equivalents) and identity protocols such as SAML, OpenID Connect, and OAuth. Strong understanding of Identity Governance, Privileged Access Management (PAM) principles, Non-Human Identities/AI Identities and Access Certification processes. Proficiency in a general-purpose programming language (e.g., Python, Go), with experience in infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and CI/CD tooling (e.g., Terraform, GitHub Actions) preferred. Demonstrated experience designing least-privilege / RBAC or ABAC models at scale, and reasoning about tradeoffs between security posture and developer/user friction. Experience operating in a regulated environment (e.g., SOX) and translating control requirements into engineering work. Track record of technical leadership: driving cross-team design decisions, writing technical documentation. Additional skills Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional collaborations and drive technical security initiatives. Ability to quickly learn, adapt, and lead in fast-paced and dynamic technical environments. title: Agent Engineer
description:
The distance between an AI system that works and one that millions of people rely on every day is where the real engineering lives. Crossing it is what Agent Engineers at Sarvam do.

The agents you build go into live operation at India's largest banks, insurers, NBFCs and government departments, and at some of the country's fastest-growing companies, handling millions of real interactions, measured against outcomes the customer wants to drive.

The hard part is not the first version. It is everything after: mapping the full space of what an agent has to handle so the scenarios that matter are covered by design rather than discovered in production, engineering for the failure modes instead of the happy path, and building the evals and instrumentation that make quality measurable, so drift surfaces in the data rather than in a customer escalation.

We treat agents as code. Not prompts someone tweaks in a console, but engineered artifacts: versioned, reviewed, and held to a regression suite, where you can reason about what a change will do and roll it back if you are wrong. Anyone who has watched an AI system quietly decay because nobody could tell which change broke it understands why this matters.

And then doing it again for the next customer, faster, because you built the first one to be repeatable.


ABOUT SARVAM

Sarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.


WHAT THIS ROLE PROMISES YOU

Production, at real scale

Not prototypes, not demos. Systems in live operation at some of India's largest institutions, carrying real volume, measured against outcomes the customer has signed up to. You will see the consequences of your engineering decisions within days.

You work at the source

Sarvam builds the whole stack: the foundational models, the infrastructure they run on, and the products on top of them. When a deployment needs something that does not exist yet, whether that is model behaviour, an infrastructure capability or a product change, you are not filing a ticket with a vendor and waiting on a roadmap. You are in a room with the people who built it. Anyone who has delivered AI on top of someone else's black box knows how much difference that makes.

A genuinely broad surface

Sarvam's products span conversational AI, agentic workflows, intelligent document processing, and content, including dubbing and document translation. You will own a motion and go deep in it, and the depth you build travels well as products mature and new ones ship.
